title: Run plan v1
description: What a run is going to measure, declared before any paid call: the subjects and suites it reads, the models, harnesses and grader it uses, the one variable its arms vary, and every cell (arm x model x task x rep) it promises to run. A result.v1 points back at a plan by plan_digest (dokimi.runner.plan.plan_digest); completeness is computed from the plan's cells, never from what happened to finish.

generated_at.description: Left out of plan_digest: re-stamping a plan does not change it.

subjects.description: What is under test: a skill, repository, doc source or profile, pinned by commit and content.

sha.description: commit the subject was read at; null when it is not in git

fingerprint.description: digest of the subject's content as the run sees it

hash.description: digest of the suite's task/question content

reasons.description: why this suite was selected (changed file, label, policy)

models.description: requested model ids; null for a cell that calls no model (an oracle or probe harness)

digest.description: digest of the verifier or judge prompt the run grades with

varied_variable.description: The one thing the arms differ in. A list names a factorial design (2x2: code and guidance), not several free variables.

cell_id.description: dokimi.runner.plan.cell_id(arm, model, task, rep): stable across re-plans
